audit_metadata.skip_reason: Services offline (backend http://localhost:3001 and frontend http://localhost:5173 not reachable); static-mode analysis only

escalations.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection (8 CVEs, CVSS 9.8)
escalations.reason: Template injection vulnerability in test infrastructure — attacker can inject arbitrary JS via malformed Handlebars templates

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution (10 CVEs, CVSS 9.8)
escalations.reason: Malformed protobuf descriptors can trigger RCE in the orchestrator that runs all agent pipelines

escalations.title: Proxy-addr IPv4-Mapped IPv6 IP Spoofing / Auth Bypass (CVSS 9.1)
escalations.reason: Bypasses IP-based access controls via IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses — falls under 'auth bypass' security trigger
escalations.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm update express; cd platform/orchestrator && npm update express

escalations.title: Vitest UI Arbitrary File Read and Code Execution (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.reason: If Vitest UI server runs on CI, any network attacker can read arbitrary files (.env, secrets) and execute code via mock injection

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer excludes portal/ — entire application tree unchecked
p1_findings.failure_scenario: Enforcer scans only Source/ and reports 76 FRs MISSING from dev-workflow-platform spec, even though ~96% are implemented in portal/. False alarms hide real drift; portal/ compliance is completely invisible.

p1_findings.title: Tinypool Prototype Pollution → RCE (transitive via Vitest)
p1_findings.reason: Fixed by same vitest update as DEP-004 — no separate escalation needed, but tracks as P1 until resolved

p2_findings.title: dependencyCheckDuration histogram missing from Source/Backend metrics
p2_findings.failure_scenario: GET /metrics on Source/ backend returns no dependency_check_duration histogram; dashboards and alerting get no data
p2_findings.recommendation: Add dependencyCheckDuration Histogram to Source/Backend/src/metrics.ts matching portal/ label schema (check_type)

p2_findings.title: 3 FR-dependency-* requirements self-reported incomplete (api-types, seed, 2 test files)
p2_findings.failure_scenario: TypeScript strict-mode catch on 'as any' cast; blocked_by changes lost on PATCH; fresh environments missing seed data; DependencySection and BlockedBadge have zero test coverage
p2_findings.recommendation: Add blocked_by?: string[] to shared API types; create portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts; add DependencySection.test.tsx and BlockedBadge.test.tsx

p2_findings.title: Specifications/tiered-merge-pipeline.md — 10 FRs with 0% implementation
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Spec drifts from system as workflow engine evolves; future implementation becomes harder
p2_findings.recommendation: Create Plans/tiered-merge-pipeline/requirements.md and dispatch to TheATeam, OR annotate spec as 'Phase 2 — not yet planned'

p2_findings.title: grpc-js Server Crash + Auth Context Bug (CVSS 7.5)
Brace-Expansion DoS — 6 CVEs via exponential expansion
Vite Path Traversal and Command Execution — 8 CVEs
PostCSS XSS and Arbitrary File Read — 4 CVEs

p3_findings.title: Duplicate test files for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage
p3_findings.recommendation: Delete top-level duplicates (tests/WorkItemDetailPage.test.tsx, tests/WorkItemListPage.test.tsx); keep /pages/ variants

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable suppressing react-hooks/exhaustive-deps without explanation
p3_findings.recommendation: Fix dependency arrays or add explanatory comments documenting why deps are intentionally excluded

p4_findings.title: Non-FR traceability comment in DebugPortalPage not enforcer-visible
p4_findings.recommendation: Assign a real FR-XXX identifier or use // Note: debug-only page, no functional requirement

cross_references.root_cause: Express and proxy-addr out of date
cross_references.single_fix: npm update express in Source/Backend and platform/orchestrator
cross_references.fix_impact: Eliminates P1 auth bypass + P2 DoS with one command per component

cross_references.root_cause: Vitest / Vite testing toolchain severely out of date (3 major versions behind)
cross_references.single_fix: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vitest vite @vitest/mocker tinypool postcss nanoid source-map-js browserslist ws
cross_references.fix_impact: Eliminates 2 P1s + 7 P2s across Frontend with a single update sweep

cross_references.root_cause: Enforcer scope gap: portal/ excluded from source.dirs
cross_references.note: Once fixed, re-run enforcer to establish true FR-001 to FR-069 baseline — may surface additional P2s or clear them
